day_shape: 80 items dominated by heavy Khamenei Fatemiyeh mourning cycle and an IRGC Brig. Gen. Heidari missile-city press blitz threatening US bases to Europe, alongside reported Iranian attack on navigation systems at Oman's Didamar, G7 pressure warning, Argentina tit-for-tat terror designation, and Treasury Secretary Bessent's relocation to a military base.

threads.label: Rezaei and Heidari threaten US bases, nuclear red line
threads.summary: SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei told Al-Mayadeen that any US base from West Asia to Europe would be a legitimate target if Washington attacks again, and ruled out transferring enriched nuclear material abroad. Armed Forces Deputy Chief Brig. Gen. Heidari claimed an organised target bank with no geographical limits, underground missile production, and asserted two US destroyers were disabled on 16–17 Shahrivar.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Gulf shipping
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iran attacked ship navigation systems on Oman's Didamar island in the Strait of Hormuz, with damage extent unclear. CENTCOM said US forces were working to keep the Strait open, enforce a naval blockade on Iran, and block IRGC land and Caspian Sea smuggling routes.

threads.label: Western pressure, diplomacy and Trump remarks
threads.summary: G7 foreign ministers warned of continued economic and political pressure if diplomacy with Iran fails, while Qatar and other mediators were reported trying to bridge US-Iran differences. Trump said at Arlington the war would end soon but demanded "total victory," and Iran won 144 votes to join a UN committee.

threads.label: Iran–Argentina terror designations, Europe plots
threads.summary: Iran designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations in reciprocal action after Buenos Aires blacklisted the IRGC, citing the 1994 AMIA bombing. The Jerusalem Post reported an Iran-backed network allegedly behind 18 attacks across Europe including a plot against a UK air base, and Iran International covered France's cyberattack attribution to the IRGC.

threads.label: Khamenei Fatemiyeh mourning cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted extensive coverage of the second night of Fatemiyeh mourning ceremonies at Zeynabiyeh, led by Ayatollah Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, including recitations by Hanif Taheri and Saeid Hadadyan. The channel also issued condolence messages for artist Kourosh Zarei and writer Mansoor Anouri.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and commemoration calendar
threads.summary: Iran International reported workers selling organs to cover debts, students without heating as gas cuts loom, and public anger over the missile-city unveiling given poverty and lack of shelters. Iran added 23 commemorations to its calendar including days marking the US-Israeli war and the killing of Ali Khamenei, confirmed by a Defa Press list.

threads.label: Yemen, Lebanon and regional spillover
threads.summary: The UN Security Council 2140 Committee held informal consultations on the Yemen Panel of Experts' final report, while Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed 93 Saudi airstrikes in 24 hours and a ballistic strike on a Saudi-led command centre. Lebanese ISF arrested five Hezbollah members in northern Lebanon, and former Iraqi MP Ahmed al-Alwani was reportedly killed in Beirut.

events.summary_en: Condolence message from the Supreme Leader following the death of committed and revolutionary artist Kourosh Zarei. Ayatollah Seyed Mujtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message expressed condolences on the death of committed and revolutionary artist Kourosh Zarei. The text of the Supreme Leader's message is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Merciful. The death of Mr Kourosh Zarei, a committed and revolutionary artist of the country, is a cause of regret. The tireless activities of that deceased in developing the performing arts in cities and less-developed areas of the country and his steadfastness in the values of the Islamic revolution were admirable. While expressing my condolences to his family and the country's artistic community, I pray to Almighty God.

events.title_en: Condolence message from the Supreme Leader following the death of revolutionary writer Mansoor Anouri
events.summary_en: Condolence message from the Supreme Leader following the death of revolutionary writer Mansoor Anouri. Ayatollah Seyed Mujtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message expressed condolences on the death of committed and revolutionary writer Mr Mansoor Anouri. The text of the Supreme Leader's message is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Merciful. The death of Mr Mansoor Anouri, a committed and revolutionary writer, was a cause of regret. That deceased, by creating multiple works including the twelve-volume novel 'Road of War' which was the subject of attention and praise by the martyr fighting Imam, paid his debt to the Islamic revolution. While expressing my condolences to his family and the country's literary community, I pray to Almighty God.

events.title: Iran labels Argentine navy, air force terrorist groups
events.summary: Iran designated Argentina’s navy and air force as terrorist organizations on Wednesday, invoking a 2019 law on reciprocal action after Buenos Aires designated Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) as a terrorist organization.

events.title: US Treasury chief moves to military base after Iranian threats
events.summary: The US Treasury Department confirmed on Tuesday that Secretary Scott Bessent had relocated from his Washington home to a military base following threats against his life from Iran.
